title: Can I BEAT Dangerous Intersection?
summary: Achievement hunt: chess.com's 'Dangerous Intersection' award for playing 4-Player Chess (FFA, points-based). Side quest: win first place. He plays yellow (moves third) vs ~1600-1900 players with 1-minute + 7s/move clocks; captures score points (bishops = 5 like rooks on the big board, promoted queens worth 1), checkmating a king scores ~20 points. He finishes ahead on points (51 vs red's 15) to take first, but the award does not appear to unlock.
rules: chess.com 4-Player Chess, Free-for-All: 14x14 board with 3x3 corners removed (160 squares); four armies Red (bottom, moves 1st), Blue (left, 2nd), Yellow (top, 3rd), Green (right, 4th); turn order clockwise.
Each player's pawns promote on reaching the centre line ('cross this little center dot'), i.e. the 8th rank from their side (to a 1-point promoted queen).

Points: pawn 1, knight 3, bishop 5, rook 5, queen 9; promoted queen 1; checkmating a king ~20 points (narrator's estimate); eliminated players' pieces turn grey and are worth 0 (inferred standard rule).
Game ends when one player remains or by time/resign; highest points wins.
Clock: 1 minute base + 7 seconds per move.
win_condition: Finish with the most points (first place).

opponent.name: Three online humans (~1600-1900)
opponent.avatar_description: chess.com default avatars beside each colour with point scores.

board.theme_notes: chess.com 4-player grey/white board; red, blue, yellow, green piece sets; scores beside board; trophy/award screen.

custom_pieces.name: 4-colour armies

setup: Each army on its edge arm: back rank R N B Q K B N R (Red/Yellow: Q on left of K from own view; Blue/Green: mirrored per chess.com), pawns in front, on the 8 central files/ranks of its arm.
events: Award popup check at end (did not unlock)
